heading_en: Exposures to the Three Types of Local Public Corporations
summary_ja: 土地開発公社・地方住宅供給公社・地方道路公社向けの円建て・円調達エクスポージャーは二十パーセント、それ以外は日本国政府の格付等に応じた第二十五条各号の表による。
summary_en: Yen exposures to land development, housing supply and road public corporations funded in yen take 20%; others follow the Article 25 tables.
paragraphs: The risk weight of yen-denominated exposures to land development public corporations, local housing supply public corporations and local road public corporations that are funded in yen shall be 20%.

Except in the case of the preceding paragraph, the risk weight of exposures to land development public corporations, local housing supply public corporations and local road public corporations shall be as set out in the left column of the table of each item of Article 25, according to the credit risk category corresponding to the rating or country risk score assigned to the Government of Japan.
